text: Inlining removes the ExecutionContext save/restore and the captured SynchronizationContext/TaskScheduler continuation context. The JIT tracks resumed_F flags; after a resumed inlinee returns it calls AsyncHelpers.RestoreInlinedFrameContexts, because it cannot switch context without posting a callback. It pays off because the context is rarely changed (IsOnRightContext is almost always true). Awaits that may suspend in try regions are still not inlined (docs/design/coreclr/jit/runtime-async-inlining.md).
